; reMarkable Monitor sleep override 1.0.0. Original sleep artwork is untouched.
; Sleep-screen selectors: ingatellent/xovi-qmd-extensions, OS 3.28.
; No timer, network connection, or AppLoad navigation is added.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    IMPORT Qt.labs.folderlistmodel 2.15
    IMPORT Qt.labs.settings 1.0 MonitorStore
    TRAVERSE ?#rootItem
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: monitorSleepController
                visible: false
                property bool initializing: true
                property string consumedTemporary: ""
                property bool scannedTemporary: false
                property var seenPings: ({})
                property int fileRevision: 0
                property string temporaryToken: {
                    fileRevision;
                    return monitorTemporaryFiles.count > 0 ? monitorTemporaryFiles.get(0, "fileName") : "";
                }
                property string persistentToken: {
                    fileRevision;
                    return monitorPersistentFiles.count > 0 ? monitorPersistentFiles.get(0, "fileName") : "";
                }
                property string imageUrl: temporaryToken !== "" && temporaryToken !== consumedTemporary
                    ? monitorTemporaryFiles.get(0, "fileUrl")
                    : persistentToken !== "" ? monitorPersistentFiles.get(0, "fileUrl") : ""
                MonitorStore.Settings {
                    id: monitorControlStore
                    fileName: "/home/root/.remarkable-monitor-sleep/control.ini"
                }
                FolderListModel {
                    id: monitorTemporaryFiles
                    folder: "file:///home/root/.remarkable-monitor-sleep/temporary/"
                    nameFilters: ["*.png"]
                    showDirs: false
                    onStatusChanged: {
                        if (status === FolderListModel.Ready && !monitorSleepController.scannedTemporary) {
                            monitorSleepController.scannedTemporary = true;
                            // A UI restart/reboot ends the previous temporary session.
                            var token = count > 0 ? get(0, "fileName") : "";
                            monitorControlStore.setValue("ConsumedTemporary", token);
                            monitorControlStore.sync();
                            monitorSleepController.consumedTemporary = token;
                            monitorSleepController.applyImagePolicy();
                        }
                        monitorSleepController.filesChanged();
                    }
                }
                FolderListModel {
                    id: monitorPersistentFiles
                    folder: "file:///home/root/.remarkable-monitor-sleep/persistent/"
                    nameFilters: ["*.png"]
                    showDirs: false
                    onStatusChanged: monitorSleepController.filesChanged()
                }
                FolderListModel {
                    id: monitorPingFiles
                    folder: "file:///home/root/.remarkable-monitor-sleep/requests/"
                    nameFilters: ["*.ping"]
                    showDirs: false
                    onCountChanged: Qt.callLater(monitorSleepController.acknowledgePings)
                    onStatusChanged: Qt.callLater(monitorSleepController.acknowledgePings)
                }
                Connections {
                    target: monitorTemporaryFiles
                    function onRowsInserted() { monitorSleepController.filesChanged(); }
                    function onRowsRemoved() { monitorSleepController.filesChanged(); }
                    function onModelReset() { monitorSleepController.filesChanged(); }
                    function onDataChanged() { monitorSleepController.filesChanged(); }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: monitorPersistentFiles
                    function onRowsInserted() { monitorSleepController.filesChanged(); }
                    function onRowsRemoved() { monitorSleepController.filesChanged(); }
                    function onModelReset() { monitorSleepController.filesChanged(); }
                    function onDataChanged() { monitorSleepController.filesChanged(); }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: monitorPingFiles
                    function onRowsInserted() { Qt.callLater(monitorSleepController.acknowledgePings); }
                    function onRowsRemoved() { Qt.callLater(monitorSleepController.acknowledgePings); }
                    function onModelReset() { Qt.callLater(monitorSleepController.acknowledgePings); }
                    function onDataChanged() { Qt.callLater(monitorSleepController.acknowledgePings); }
                }
                function filesChanged() {
                    fileRevision += 1;
                    Qt.callLater(acknowledgePings);
                }
                function acknowledgePings() {
                    if (initializing || monitorPingFiles.status !== FolderListModel.Ready
                            || monitorTemporaryFiles.status !== FolderListModel.Ready
                            || monitorPersistentFiles.status !== FolderListModel.Ready) { return; }
                    applyImagePolicy();
                    for (var index = 0; index < monitorPingFiles.count; ++index) {
                        var token = monitorPingFiles.get(index, "fileName");
                        if (!seenPings[token]) {
                            seenPings[token] = true;
                            monitorControlStore.setValue("LiveToken", token);
                        }
                    }
                    recordState();
                }
                function recordState() {
                    monitorControlStore.setValue("Awake", BatteryManager.displayState === BatteryManager.Normal);
                    monitorControlStore.setValue("DisplayState", BatteryManager.displayState);
                    monitorControlStore.sync();
                }
                function applyImagePolicy() {
                    if (initializing) { return; }
                    try {
                        if (typeof Settings.lightSleepEnabled !== "boolean") {
                            throw new Error("The native Visible content setting is unavailable");
                        }
                        if (imageUrl !== "") {
                            if (!monitorControlStore.value("OriginalVisibleContentSaved", false)) {
                                monitorControlStore.setValue("OriginalVisibleContent", Settings.lightSleepEnabled);
                                monitorControlStore.setValue("OriginalVisibleContentSaved", true);
                            }
                            Settings.lightSleepEnabled = false;
                        } else if (monitorControlStore.value("OriginalVisibleContentSaved", false)) {
                            Settings.lightSleepEnabled = monitorControlStore.value("OriginalVisibleContent", false);
                            monitorControlStore.setValue("OriginalVisibleContentSaved", false);
                        }
                        monitorControlStore.setValue("PolicyError", "");
                    } catch (error) {
                        monitorControlStore.setValue("PolicyError", String(error));
                    }
                    monitorControlStore.sync();
                }
                onImageUrlChanged: {
                    applyImagePolicy();
                    monitorControlStore.setValue("RequestedImage", String(imageUrl));
                    monitorControlStore.sync();
                }
                Image {
                    id: monitorImageCheck
                    visible: false
                    cache: false
                    source: monitorSleepController.imageUrl
                    onStatusChanged: {
                        if (status === Image.Ready) {
                            monitorSleepController.applyImagePolicy();
                            monitorControlStore.setValue("ReadyImage", String(source));
                            monitorControlStore.setValue("ImageWidth", sourceSize.width);
                            monitorControlStore.setValue("ImageHeight", sourceSize.height);
                        } else {
                            monitorControlStore.setValue("ReadyImage", "");
                        }
                        monitorControlStore.sync();
                    }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: BatteryManager
                    function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
                        if (next === BatteryManager.Normal && previous !== BatteryManager.Normal) {
                            // Consume a temporary override on the native wake event.
                            // A preserved image continues to apply to future sleeps.
                            monitorControlStore.setValue("ConsumedTemporary", monitorSleepController.temporaryToken);
                            monitorControlStore.sync();
                            monitorSleepController.consumedTemporary = monitorSleepController.temporaryToken;
                            monitorSleepController.applyImagePolicy();
                        }
                        monitorSleepController.recordState();
                    }
                }
                Component.onCompleted: {
                    monitorControlStore.sync();
                    consumedTemporary = String(monitorControlStore.value("ConsumedTemporary", ""));
                    initializing = false;
                    applyImagePolicy();
                    monitorControlStore.setValue("RequestedImage", String(imageUrl));
                    monitorControlStore.setValue("ReadyImage", monitorImageCheck.status === Image.Ready ? String(monitorImageCheck.source) : "");
                    monitorControlStore.setValue("ImageWidth", monitorImageCheck.sourceSize.width);
                    monitorControlStore.setValue("ImageHeight", monitorImageCheck.sourceSize.height);
                    recordState();
                    monitorControlStore.setValue("LoadedVersion", "1.0.0");
                    monitorControlStore.setValue("LoadedAt", String(Date.now()));
                    monitorControlStore.sync();
                    Qt.callLater(acknowledgePings);
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
